- heading "Why do the leaves on my Neanthe Bella Palm have specks or look dusty and dull?" [level=4]:
      - strong: Why do the leaves on my Neanthe Bella Palm have specks or look dusty and dull?
    - paragraph:
      - text: Some houseplants are more prone to common pests than others, and this is one of them. Neanthe Bellas are susceptible to
      - link "spider mites":
        - /url: https://www.joyusgarden.com/how-to-get-rid-of-spider-mites-on-indoor-plants/
      - text: (tiny sap-suckers) that cause pale specks, dull-looking leaves, and a mottled appearance. If things progress, you may spot fine webbing.
    - paragraph: Back in my interiorscaping days, I noticed these pests often appeared when the heat kicked on in the fall and winter—like they came out of nowhere!
    - heading "How do I clean my Parlor Palm?" [level=4]:
      - strong: How do I clean my Parlor Palm?
    - paragraph: It’s best to give your beautiful indoor palm a gentle rinse in the shower or take it outside for a good hosing. I clean mine once or twice a year—it not only looks good, but clean leaves help the plant breathe and stay healthier.

      - text: A guide to
      - link "cleaning houseplants":
        - /url: https://www.joyusgarden.com/cleaning-houseplants/
